approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C++; XDK 5233 HLE with a native Vulkan renderer and SDL3 on Linux (no Wine), Direct3D 12 and XAudio2 cross-compiled for Windows
help: Camera zoom: the per-call step is now rescaled by the call rate (sub_00011ED0; SIMS1_NO_ZOOMRATE=1 to compare). The uncapped-vs-60 A/B was cut short by a release call, so confirm by feel and check rotate/cursor rates against a console too (docs/zoom-rate.md)

If no sound is heard on Linux: the port mixes and delivers audio correctly (proven to a RUNNING sink); this machine's only output is the HDMI monitor at 40% - check the monitor's own speakers. In-game music/dialogue beyond the intro movie has not been listened to by a human
Exercise the Windows target (Direct3D 12 + XAudio2): it cross-compiles but has never been run
Drive the four cheats only confirmed by log (FREEALL, MIDAS, PARTY M, PICTURES) to their visible effects (docs/cheats.md)
Hor+ ultrawide: the frame target widens, but the title's own aspect path has not been analysed as the siblings' was (docs/guest-projection.md on Bustin' Out is the model)
The full-screen movies are copied raw over all 480 rows, so the measured 24-row picture crop trims them top and bottom (docs/picture-rect.md); a movie-path exception may be worth it
notes: In progress - boots, plays its intro movies, reaches menus, Create a Sim and a playable household in live mode unattended (17 of 17 runs, 860-2208 draws a frame, docs/playtest.md). XDK 5233 was unsupported by the SDK: the signature set was seeded from 5558 and then signed from this image, the CDevice layout was proven offset by offset (its miniport sits at +0x17C8, 26 of 31 offsets differ from 5558), and 128 of 242 XDK names plus 11 of 12 data are proven with per-name evidence. Two boot defects fixed on the way (docs/boot-crash.md): the unnamed Direct3D_CreateDevice running the NV2A miniport init, and a host body for D3DDevice_InsertCallback whose console body wedged the first frame. The frame-step quantiser is fixed against the host clock: game seconds per real second 1.000 at 60, 144 and uncapped (docs/frame-rate.md). The picture rect is measured, not assumed: 640x432 at y=24 (docs/picture-rect.md). The F1 settings panel (with the game's own typed-word cheats as rows) and the F2 performance panel are verified on screen.
